text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswana press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Botswana Defence Force (BDF) has denied reports of dissent among troops over its refusal to pay certain allowances.
- The BDF will send observers to a multi-nation peacekeeping operation to be held in Zimbabwe next month.

- The cattle restocking of the Ngamiland area, where more than 250,000 cattle infected with cattle lung disease were slaughtered, is under threat because the disease is now rampant in neighbouring Namibia. Five border fences are under construction to stop cattle crossing into Botswana.
